title: Kiosk off in production until fixed
requirementRefs: _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/epics.md Story 12.5 (Traceability: PAY-3, KSK-4; audit P0-19, section 4.10; depends on Story 1.5)
PRD/product-requirements.md PAY-3: payment amount equals the server-computed total; missing provider configuration fails closed in production
PRD/product-requirements.md KSK-4: no card data stored or queued; submission requires durable acceptance
PRD/product-requirements.md section 15 row N: stable, documented error contracts with safe messages
PRD/product-requirements.md section 16 items 10, 15, 16: abuse resistance, secure production configuration, safe error responses
docs/audits/production-readiness-2026-12.md P0-19 and section 4.10 (evidence and backlog input only)
Precedent for the 404 status: epics.md Story 2.3 acceptance criterion 'it does not exist (404)', implemented in apps/api/src/media/providers/local-media-availability.ts (commit fe3e98b)
architectureConstraints: fileRestructure.md section 7.1: the kiosk ordering path is transitional (Nest POST /api/kiosk/orders, web KioskOrderPage); the change stays in the transitional NestJS API (apps/api/src) and creates no new canonical owner
Prisma (apps/api/prisma) stays the migration authority and is not changed: no schema or migration change

Production is decided per request from validated configuration (ConfigService NODE_ENV) and fails closed: any value other than exactly development or test is production (apps/api/src/config/runtime-environment.ts, Stories 1.5 and 2.3)

acceptanceCriteria.given: the API runs with production configuration (NODE_ENV=production)
acceptanceCriteria.when: a request that gets past the existing CSRF middleware reaches POST /api/kiosk/orders, POST /api/kiosk/stripe/create-payment-intent or POST /api/kiosk/stripe/connection-token
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 404 Not Found, as for a route that does not exist, with no kiosk, Stripe, configuration or environment detail in the body. The orders service, the database and Stripe are never reached.

acceptanceCriteria.when: any of the three entry points is requested
acceptanceCriteria.then: the refusal happens before rate limiting: the rate-limit store is never consulted, so requests beyond the limit, or with the rate-limit store unavailable, still get 404 and never 429 or 503

acceptanceCriteria.when: any of the three entry points is requested with an empty or invalid body
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 404, not a validation error (400)

acceptanceCriteria.given: NODE_ENV is unset, or is any value other than exactly development or test
acceptanceCriteria.when: any of the three entry points is requested
acceptanceCriteria.then: it behaves exactly as under production (404)

acceptanceCriteria.when: the three entry points are requested
acceptanceCriteria.then: their behaviour is unchanged from the baseline: the rate limiter is consulted, the body is validated, and the matching orders-service operation is called

acceptanceCriteria.when: GET /api/kiosk/venues/:venueId/tables, GET /api/kiosk/venues/:venueId/menu or POST /api/kiosk/kds/auth is requested
acceptanceCriteria.then: each reaches its handler and behaves as on the baseline

acceptanceCriteria.when: a reader inspects the three kiosk mutation paths

acceptanceCriteria.given: the existing API unit suite, lint and typecheck
acceptanceCriteria.then: they pass, with no test removed, skipped or weakened and no lint or type suppression added

completionCriteria: Every mandatory check passes on the candidate
Every required test exists in apps/api/src/orders/kiosk-production-availability.spec.ts and passes. RT-1 to RT-6 fail on the baseline.
The candidate changes only the allowed surfaces and none of the forbidden ones
The orchestrator decides acceptance; nothing is merged or pushed by the run

requiredTests.name: in production, POST /api/kiosk/orders answers 404 before rate limiting and the service
in production, POST /api/kiosk/stripe/create-payment-intent answers 404 before rate limiting and the service
in production, POST /api/kiosk/stripe/connection-token answers 404 before rate limiting and the service
in production, an invalid body still answers 404
in production, an unavailable rate-limit store does not change the 404
an unset or unrecognised NODE_ENV is treated as production
in development and test, the kiosk order and payment routes keep their behaviour
in production, kiosk menu and table reads and the KDS PIN exchange are unchanged

expectationChanges.reason: Only if the production gate's dependencies stop the existing TestingModule from compiling: add the missing provider (for example ConfigService with NODE_ENV=test). Nothing else changes; no test is removed, skipped or weakened.
